channel.title: Frontion News Headlines
channel.description: Breaking geopolitical headlines from Tier 1 sources

item.title: 🇺🇦 Russia kills 10 in ballistic missile strike on drone exhibition near Kyiv
item.description: Russian forces fired three ballistic missiles at a drone technology exhibition near Kyiv, killing at least 10 people and wounding around 100. The targeted event was attended by prominent members of Ukraine defence industry, raising questions about operational security.

item.title: 🇵🇸 Israel approves international stabilisation force for Gaza under Trump peace plan
item.description: Israel security cabinet approved the entry of an International Stabilisation Force into Gaza, part of Trump 20-point peace plan. The force will include 200 personnel from friendly countries and operate in coordination with the Israeli military, with Israel retaining authority over which nations can participate.

item.title: 🇭🇳 Former Honduran President Hernández returns home after Trump pardon, faces domestic charges
item.description: Juan Orlando Hernández, convicted in the US for drug trafficking and sentenced to 45 years, returned to Honduras after Trump pardoned him claiming the trial was a Biden-era setup. He now faces fraud and money-laundering charges in Honduras, though activists fear the prosecution will be a sham.

item.title: 🇩🇪 Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed by German police
item.description: Abdul Ballout, a 21-year-old German-Lebanese citizen suspected of driving a van into a Pride crowd in Berlin, was shot and killed by police after rushing at officers with a knife. Germany has raised its threat level following the attack that killed one woman and injured 29.

item.title: 🇬🇧🇺🇦 UK PM Burnham pledges unwavering Ukraine support, shares electronic warfare tech
item.description: New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham made Zelenskyy his first international visitor, announcing the sharing of Britain's "Stone Cloak" drone-jamming technology IP with Ukraine for domestic production, alongside new cruise missile development plans.

item.title: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 US-Iran fighting paused but both sides face uncertain off-ramp
item.description: After nearly two weeks of daily strikes, the US has paused bombing Iran for two nights. Diplomatic efforts continue over the Strait of Hormuz, but Netanyahu's upcoming White House visit and dwindling munitions concerns add uncertainty to whether the pause becomes lasting peace.

item.title: 🇸🇾🇮🇱 Syria's al-Sharaa seeks security deal with Israel in exclusive interview
item.description: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa told Al Jazeera that Damascus is actively pursuing a security agreement with Israel that could serve as a gateway to comprehensive peace, while insisting it would not compromise Syria's claim to the occupied Golan Heights.

item.title: 🇮🇱 Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of fomenting hate after ICC arrest threat
item.description: Israeli PM Netanyahu said he would attend the UN General Assembly in New York this fall despite Mayor Mamdani's earlier threat to arrest him on ICC war crimes charges. Netanyahu accused Mamdani of dividing New Yorkers, referencing recent hate crime stabbings in the city.

item.title: 🇺🇸 Multiple people shot at Seattle food festival near Space Needle
item.description: Several people were injured in a shooting at the Bite of Seattle festival at Seattle Center, a popular annual event drawing hundreds of thousands. Police urged people to avoid the area as the investigation continued.

item.title: 🇨🇺 Cuba president accuses US of genocide and seeking takeover amid crippling oil embargo
item.description: President Miguel Diaz-Canel denounced the US oil embargo — in place since January — as genocide at a rally marking the 73rd anniversary of the Cuban Revolution. The embargo has caused daily blackouts exceeding 20 hours, with major companies withdrawing from the country.

item.title: 🏛️ US appeals court upholds block on Trump executive order creating federal voter list
item.description: A federal appeals court upheld a lower court ruling halting Trumps executive order that would create a federal citizenship voter list and restrict mail ballot delivery. The 1st Circuit rejected the administrations attempt to implement the order in 23 states that sued.

item.title: 🇫🇷 Macron calls crisis cabinet meeting as wildfire closes in on Bordeaux
item.description: French President Macron convened an emergency cabinet meeting as Europes devastating wildfires edged within 15km of Bordeaux. Over 220,000 people have been evacuated in southwestern France alone, with firefighters describing a David-versus-Goliath battle against a fire creating its own thunderstorms.

item.title: 🇦🇷🇧🇷 Argentina Milei calls Brazils Lula a thief and convict, Brazil recalls ambassador
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei insulted Brazilian President Lula da Silva at a Sao Paulo rally for right-wing candidate Flavio Bolsonaro, calling him a thief and convict. Brazil responded by recalling its ambassador from Buenos Aires, escalating a diplomatic crisis between the two largest South American economies.

item.title: 🇷🇺🇺🇦 Russia cancels annual Navy Day parade in St. Petersburg as Ukrainian deep-strike capabilities threaten major cities
item.description: Russia has canceled its annual Navy Day parade in St. Petersburg for the second year in a row, as Ukraine increasing deep-strike capabilities put even heavily defended Russian cities at risk.

item.title: 🇰🇵🇷🇺 Russia seeking 30,000 more troops from North Korea, Zelenskyy says
item.description: Moscow and Pyongyang signed a mutual assistance pact in 2024, and Zelenskyy says Russia now wants 30,000 additional North Korean troops for the war in Ukraine.

item.title: 🇨🇳🇵🇱 China blacklists Polish university on European dual-use export controls list
item.description: China has added a Polish university to its dual-use exports blacklist, signaling escalating tech tensions between Beijing and European institutions over sensitive technology transfers.

item.title: 🇺🇦🚢 Civilian cargo ship carrying grain sinks in Black Sea near Odesa after Russian missile strike
item.description: A civilian cargo ship sank on July 26 in the Black Sea near Odesa after being struck by Russian missiles on July 19 while transporting grain, marking another attack on civilian shipping.

item.title: ⚔️🇺🇸🇬🇧 US Air Force EA-37B electronic warfare aircraft arrive at RAF Fairford as Iran threatens UK base
item.description: EA-37B Compass Call aircraft have deployed to RAF Fairford in the UK, a key hub for USAF bomber missions against Iran, as Tehran threatens to attack the British air base.

item.title: 🇺🇸⚔️ Pentagon quietly removes 4 US troop deaths from Iran war casualty count
item.description: The Defense Department removed four American soldiers killed during renewed Iran fighting from its official war toll, reclassifying them under a new "Overseas Operations" category. The move raises questions about transparency as the Trump administration faces growing scrutiny over the conflict's human cost.

item.title: 🇮🇳✊ India Cockroach Janta protests force education minister resignation in blow to Modi
item.description: A Gen Z movement dubbed the Cockroach Janta Party forced the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan after leaked exam papers sparked mass protests and student suicides. The unprecedented uprising poses the biggest challenge to Modi's grip on power since he took office in 2014.

item.title: 🇧🇷🏛️ Brazil denies visas to US officials amid election interference concerns
item.description: Brazil's Foreign Ministry denied visas to two US State Department officials who sought to travel to Brasilia, calling their visit an attempt to cast doubt on October's presidential elections. The move escalates diplomatic tensions between the Lula and Trump administrations over tariffs and election integrity.

item.title: 🇺🇦🕊️ Ukraine and US discuss air ceasefire proposal ahead of Trump-Zelensky meeting
item.description: Ukrainian and US officials have discussed proposing an air ceasefire to Russia, Reuters reports, ahead of Volodymyr Zelenskyy's visit to Washington on Tuesday. The Kremlin called it premature to comment. Romania shot down a third Russian drone in three days, and a cargo ship sank off Odesa after a Russian attack killed 9 crew.

item.title: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 US pauses Iran strikes for second night as military advises against escalation
item.description: The US paused airstrikes on Iran for a second consecutive night after top military officials warned Trump about dwindling munitions stockpiles and the limits of the bombing campaign. Iran also halted retaliatory operations. Diplomatic negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz continue amid a two-week surge in violence that killed 4 US soldiers.

item.title: 🇮🇷⚔️ Iran says Ukrainian attack on vessel in Caspian Sea killed a sailor
item.description: Iran confirmed that a Ukrainian naval drone strike on a vessel in the Caspian Sea killed one sailor, marking an escalation of the Ukraine-Russia conflict into the Caspian region and raising concerns about the war expanding beyond the Black Sea.

item.title: 🇩🇪🏳️‍🌈 Berlin Pride attack was Islamist terror, says German interior minister; suspect shot dead
item.description: Germany declared the deadly ramming attack near Berlin Pride an Islamist terror act. The suspect, a German-Lebanese citizen and IS supporter, was shot dead by police after a 24-hour manhunt. One woman was killed and 29 injured.
